about.title: About
about.intro: A property operations practitioner in Bali who builds his own AI systems.
about.backgroundText: I run operations for rental properties in Bali. This work taught me that the biggest problem is rarely a lack of effort — it's processes that depend on people's memory, reports that are always late, and repetitive work that eats up time.
about.approachText: I build AI systems to solve those problems, then use them myself every day. Because I'm the user, I know what genuinely helps and what just looks impressive.
about.ctaText: Open to collaboration, consulting, and opportunities in operations and automation.
